extension.summary: LibTV - Your Kodi Library as Real TV
extension.description: Turn your movies and TV shows into linear channels with full TV guide support. Generates an M3U playlist and XMLTV guide for PVR IPTV Simple Client, with plugin-resolved streams so channels play whatever is currently on air.
extension.news: v0.15.0: clicking a programme in the guide could start a different show. The guide you see is a snapshot from the last time the PVR client reloaded, and a rebuild used to re-pack the whole day - something as small as scanning one new episode was enough to move everything - so guide entries could point at programmes that had shifted. Rebuilds now keep the programmes they have already published and only change when the current one ends, so what is on air cannot move under you. LibTV also configures IPTV Simple to re-read the playlist and guide on its own timer: the old refresh restarted the client, which kills a playing stream and so was always skipped while you were watching - exactly when the guide drifted. Run "Auto-configure IPTV Simple Client" once to adopt that (it asks before changing an existing instance). Deleting a channel no longer frees its id for the next channel you add, which Kodi treated as the same channel. Selecting a programme that is not currently on air still tunes the channel live - there is no catch-up.
